description: One catalogue of a composer's works (Op., BWV, K., S., KK…) by slug: its chapters and its works in catalogue order, with key, date and difficulty ratings. Paged: 50 entries per page by default, at most 100. get_composer lists a composer's catalogues and their URLs (the slug is the last part).

limit.description: Entries per page: 50 by default, at most 100 (larger values are capped).

slug.description: The catalogue's slug, as in https://klavierstuck.org/catalog/<slug>, e.g. "kk-chopin".

name: get_catalog
title: Get a catalogue
